systemMessage.systemMessage: [Sennard parent link] This host's hooks do not say which conversation started this one, so Sennard cannot tell whether this is the main conversation or a subagent. If you are a subagent, call any Sennard tool once now: that call names this conversation and its parent, and from the next step Sennard gives you the parent's role context. If you are the main conversation, ignore this.
